parts.name: Legend
parts.description: A list of the series of the chart. It makes a `<ul>` with one item per series.

props.name: children
props.description:
The content of an item. It receives the name and the index of the series. Without it, an
item shows an empty `data-swatch` element and the name.

props.name: class
props.description: The CSS class names of the list.

dataAttributes.name: data-series
dataAttributes.description: On each item. The value is the name of the series.

dataAttributes.name: data-swatch
dataAttributes.description: On the empty element at the start of an item without children.
